ci_support_linux_64_python3.11.____cpyth:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version

{% set name = "soxr" %}
{% set version = "1.1.0" %}
{% set abi3_min = "3.12" %}

package:
  name: soxr-python
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/soxr-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9f228ae21c78fa9359ca98d8a5e8e91f30639e438e574133dace62c5b5309e44

build:
  python_version_independent: true       # [py == 312]
  skip: true                             # [py > 312 and not python.endswith("t")]
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv -C cmake.define.USE_SYSTEM_LIBSOXR=ON
  number: 1

requirements:
  build:
    - python                                 # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - cross-python_{{ target_platform }}     # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - cmake
    - make  # [unix]
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - nanobind >=2.0.0
    - scikit-build-core >=0.9.0
    - pip
    - python
    - python-abi3                        # [py == 312]
    - setuptools_scm
    - soxr
  run:
    - python
    - numpy

test:
  source_files:
    - tests/
  imports:
    - soxr
  commands:
    - pip check
    - pytest ./tests
    - abi3audit $SP_DIR/soxr/soxr_ext.abi3.so -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 {{ abi3_min }}   # [unix and py == 312]
    - abi3audit %SP_DIR%\soxr\soxr_ext.pyd -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 {{ abi3_min }}      # [win and py == 312]
  requires:
    - pip
    - pytest
    - abi3audit                          # [py == 312]

about:
  home: https://github.com/dofuuz/python-soxr
  summary: High quality, one-dimensional sample-rate conversion library for Python
  doc_url: https://python-soxr.readthedocs.io
  dev_url: https://github.com/dofuuz/python-soxr
  license: LGPL-2.1-or-later
  license_file:
    - COPYING.LGPL
    - LICENSE.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - dofuuz
